reasoning_content: The curl to api.github.com worked previously for rabbitmq. Let me try the seaweedfs release. Maybe the JSON doesn't have the asset name I grepped. Let me look at the assets properly.

action.command: timeout 30 curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/chrislusf/seaweedfs/releases/latest -o /tmp/seaweed.json; grep -E '"tag_name"' /tmp/seaweed.json; echo "=== linux amd64 assets ==="; grep -oE '"browser_download_url": *"[^"]*linux[^"]*"' /tmp/seaweed.json | head
